judges.notes: Blind read of all 37 PNGs by pixels only. For images with no people, the figure score grades plausibility of the main object (cabinet layout, tubes, dials) rather than anatomy; for pure text cards it grades the absence of any subject. Best on-air candidates: j26 (ensemble), j37 and j05 (cover radios), j18 and j20 (character cards), j10 and j11 (poster art). Do not air: j31, j36, j13, j34, j08 (text failures), j30 (too dark). Blind test, pixels only; all 37 files opened individually with no other file in the tree consulted. Scoring anchors: overall 9 means it goes to air untouched (j05, j22, j26, j37), 7-8 means airable with a grade or a crop, 4-6 means a fallback slate, 1-3 means reject. For images with no human subject the figure score rates the plausibility and internal consistency of the depicted object instead, so it is never a null. j13.png (ideogram4_local, scene_character) by radio-producer: Strongest: headline typography is legible and well set. Weakest: subtitle is garbage letters and there is no image at all, just a gradient.
j31.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by radio-producer: Strongest: sepia signboard framing is on-brand. Weakest: SEGIAL LOST and three lines of garbage, unairable.
j36.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by radio-producer: Strongest: woodcut poster layout and red-gold palette are right. Weakest: every word is garbage and the figures are smeared silhouettes.
j31.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by art-director: Strong: sepia vignette. Weak: every line of text is misspelled garbage, unusable on air.
j36.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by art-director: Strong: pulp woodcut palette is right. Weak: title and every caption are garbage letters, silhouettes melt.

j08.png (ideogram4_local, scene_beat) by defect-hunter: Strongest: genuinely elegant mid-century paper collage with a disciplined grid and real tonal restraint. Weakest: the one line of type in frame reads The Weight of weight of unsoken secrets - a duplicated word and a misspelling, dead center.

j13.png (ideogram4_local, scene_character) by defect-hunter: Strongest: the headline sets cleanly - correct serif letterforms, correct spelling, good leading. Weakest: the subtitle renders as The gindte tisbt, total garbage directly under readable copy, which is worse than no subtitle.

j28.png (flux2_klein, portrait) by defect-hunter: Strongest: warm sepia ink-and-wash with convincing period props - reels and stacked discs dress the frame well. Weakest: the dial banner is prominent garbage type reading roughly QUISHL S HAESPE, and the reel hubs repeat as near-identical stamps.

j31.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by defect-hunter: Strongest: the lightbox framing and vignette are at least period-plausible. Weakest: the entire image is text and the entire text is broken - Welcome bakc to SEGIAL LOST over two lines of pure gibberish. Unusable as-is.

j36.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by defect-hunter: Strongest: strong pulp-woodcut poster energy with good red-and-cream separation and real crosshatch discipline. Weakest: the title is complete garbage - TONGHE SONOEE SUGIE BOOK - plus two more garbled banner lines, and the crowd figures are undifferentiated blobs.
j08.png (ideogram4_local, scene_beat) by viewer: Strong: tasteful paper collage texture. Weak: subject is postage-stamp small and the typed caption is misspelled and duplicated.
j31.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by viewer: Strong: sepia signage vignette is on-tone. Weak: every line is misspelled gibberish, unairable.
j36.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by viewer: Strong: strong pulp woodcut poster energy. Weak: the huge title is nonsense words, cannot be shown.

j13.png (ideogram4_local, scene_character) by cinematographer: Strongest: the headline itself is correctly spelled and well set. Weakest: the subtitle is garbage letterforms and the whole card is an empty gradient.

j25.png (lumina_image, portrait) by cinematographer: Strongest: nice dim single-source mood on the wooden case. Weakest: the grille cloth aliases into a moire mesh and the set sits absurdly on a dinner plate.
j28.png (flux2_klein, portrait) by cinematographer: Strongest: warm sepia crosshatch style with reels framing the set nicely. Weakest: the dial carries invented letterforms straight across the front.

j31.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by cinematographer: Strongest: the sign shape and lightbox glow are at least period-plausible. Weakest: every line of text is scrambled, 'Welccome bakc to SEGIAL LOST' is unairable.

j36.png (lumina_image, scene_beat) by cinematographer: Strongest: handsome pulp woodcut poster style with a strong red field. Weakest: the entire title is nonsense words, which is the worst possible failure on a title card.
